dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: #Hey, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I just knew you would be making an appearance here!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Your home is breathtaking! Even a legendary magician like myself can confidently say I've never seen or heard of anything like it!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: But were I to say I've already gotten completely used to it... Would you think I'm lying?

choices.text: Sure doesn't seem like the truth.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Aw, that really hurts my feelings...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: But, I was really being honest this time!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Well, looks like I've got no choice but to stay here for a while longer! After all, it will take some time for me to win your trust again.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: ...You won't kick me out, right?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Hehe, I'm honored to have gained your trust.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: It's almost impossible for me to lie to your face... Maybe it's because I can't bear to see that hurt expression of yours.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Ahem, but back to the topic at hand! Since you care about me so much, surely you would also want me to extend my stay?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: In which case, I'll be looking forward to more of your hospitality!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to chat?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Sure thing! Say, why don't you take a look at my hat? Do you see anything different about it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh... Don't think there's any difference.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Ah, but that just means you need to look at it more carefully! Just come a bit closer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, alright then.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: So, do you have the answer? Is it the pattern, or the color? You should have seen this hat many times before.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: *sigh* What a pity... Although, your conclusion is actually correct.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: I just played a little trick, and stole something of yours. And after that, I also slipped a card into your bag.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Now, can you guess what I stole from you?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Haha, I really am quite the little thief with a nose for Mora! No wonder my pockets are always overflowing.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: What I actually stole, however, was your "attention." That's something far more valuable than Mora!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: As long as you understand and master this trick, and put some time into practicing movement, you, too, can become an outstanding magician.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: ...Okay, you can return my card to me now.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: A most unexpected answer! I have to say, even my heart has begun to race too.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: What I actually stole, however, was your "attention." Even though it's not nearly as valuable as your heart, it's still very important to us magicians nonetheless!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Bingo! Congratulations, that was the right answer.

choices.text: Is it bigger or smaller than before?

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: No, the whole thing was misdirection.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: As you're the owner, there is one matter on which I would like to inquire your opinion.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Why so formal all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: From what I can see, not only is the environment here quite comfortable, but the security is also beyond reproach. It seems this would be a great place to raise pets.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Just so you know... I've already greeted them. Politely, of course.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: I refrained from touching them or feeding them anything I had brought with me. Such actions require your permission first, no?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Why do I feel like you're being exceptionally earnest today...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Hehe, is it because I'm usually dramatic and flamboyant? That could have left you with a rather one-sided impression.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: If that's the case, I really ought to do a good bit of self-reflection!

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Anyway, I just want to find a warm, free, and peaceful home for all of my animal assistants.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: A place where they'll always enjoy care and being lovingly looked after, with no need to worry about food or shelter...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: To be perfectly honest with you, this is by far the best choice for them that I know of... but I wouldn't want you to feel pressured to take them in, or to persuade you using honeyed words.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: But if you really were willing to take them in of your own free will, truly, that would be wonderful.

choices.text: I don't really have much experience with pets...

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: No problem. As long as you aren't opposed to the idea, I'm happy to share my knowledge on the subject with you.

response.speaker: Lyney
response.text: Naturally, if you have any concerns, I will respect your thoughts and decisions.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Morning, Lyney.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: It would be great if I could see you every morning.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Lyney.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: If you ever have trouble falling asleep, I'd be happy to count cats with you until you drift off.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Wow, you really thought of everything! I just love this style of table and chairs! The color, the design... so many memories.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: It takes me right back to when Lynette and I were little, and we used to do magic tricks on the street. Just like this: Check your pockets.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Haha, yep, you guessed it — I made my move while you were focused on the table and chairs.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I assume, since you've taken the trouble to set up this gorgeous stage, that you're hoping to host a spectacular performance here.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Hey, how about the greatest magician in all of Teyvat? It just so happens that he has an open slot in his schedule at this very moment...

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: It looks like you may be the only audience member — but don't worry. The show will go ahead as scheduled.
